batch: C04a/C04b DC and nested DC control execution
source_hash_scope: Committed Git blob bytes at source_revision for changed Rust files, dependency lock and toolchain pin. Publication-ledger bytes are recorded separately.

implementation.execution: Explicit dc and declarative run reuse the public full-specification DC solver. DcSweepResult owns compact outer/inner axes and original accepted DcSweepPointResult objects with device reports. No new device equations or alternate DC solver were introduced.
implementation.presentation: Node/branch vectors, both physical coordinates, correct shared units, stable dataset identities and source-order alteration/options. Cross-dataset expressions compare all nested coordinates rather than only the repeated inner scale.
implementation.resources: Retained numeric counts include compact axes, solver results, observables and per-point reports. The remaining cumulative control budget bounds each solve. Failure/cancellation cannot publish a partial dataset or consume an ordinal.
implementation.integration: CLI and WASM deck/control adapters share the typed DC execution and document constructor. CLI keeps LIST/DEC/OCT specifications and physical units; typed documents include the outer axis. Flat CLI headers preserve authored source spelling after the follow-up repair.

independent_oracles: Equal-resistor divider: V(out)=(V1+V2)/2 and I(V1)=(V2-V1)/2000, across both nested dimensions and negative/nonmonotonic input values.
Current-source/resistor network: V(out)=1000*I1 across linear, list, decade and octave specifications.
Temperature-adjusted resistor: TC1=0.01, TNOM=27, TEMP=127 gives R=2 kOhm and source current -0.5 mA at 1 V.
scope_limits: C04 remains in progress: OP/DC/AC/TRAN implemented; 25 command variants still require execution, producer or orchestration semantics. No other package is closed.
CLI runtime qualification under pinned Rust 1.94 is not established because of the dependency compiler crash. Installed Rust 1.95 supplies the recorded CLI runtime evidence.

Selected tests do not establish whole-core/device accuracy, all configurations, allocation or performance limits, or production readiness. No external reference simulator was needed for these closed-form resistor oracles.

WASM feature selection does not prove Verilog-A JIT/model execution. Flat output formats retain their existing projection contract; complete nested coordinate metadata is carried by the core typed result and typed documents.

development_attempts.finding_and_resolution: Pinned Rust 1.94 crashes inside rustc region inference while compiling faer 0.24.4. CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 was already set. Pinned three-crate check and Clippy pass, but CLI execution here requires installed Rust 1.95. The pin was not changed.
Initial new numerical checks used a case-sensitive node-name lookup. Tests were corrected to respect case-insensitive circuit names; all six final public tests pass.
A removed adapter unit helper left an unattached doc comment; removed before the implementation commit.
The old preflight test expected DC to be unsupported. Its unsupported cases now exercise still-missing TF; invalid explicit/declarative DC cases remain covered.
Existing flat-output regression caught canonical v1 replacing authored V1. Follow-up 17ea0ca58 preserves the authored command name in shared CLI publication; all selected DC export checks then pass.
